## Change and issue

Link the actual GitHub issue number (for example, `Refs #1`), and describe the resulting user behavior. Use `Closes` only when every acceptance criterion is met.

## Verification

List executed checks and outcomes. Separate automated checks from real-device/provider evidence.

## Decisions and rollout

Link unresolved owner decisions, migrations, environment-variable names, and rollback instructions. Never include credential values or personal data.
